audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] says Ornn will 'Hit Volcanic Rupture to knock you airborne'. Volcanic Rupture does not knock up. Nothing in Ornn's Q displaces.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture sends out a fissure that damages and SLOWS, then forms a magma pillar at the end location after a delay. The knockup belongs to Searing Charge (E): he charges, and if he collides with terrain the impact shockwave knocks up. The pillar Q leaves behind is the terrain he charges into — that is the combo, and the page's own whys[2] and content.early already describe it correctly. Only wants.foe[0] gets it backwards, and it is the field that tells the reader what to fear.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[0] now sequences it properly: pillar, then Searing Charge into it, then Call of the Forge God.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart rows 1, 3, 4 and 6 disagreed with the mirror in both layers.
audit.why: The mirror set Level 2 to Skill, Levels 4-5 to Ornn, Level 6 to Ornn and 2+ items to Swain. The packet chart agrees on rows 1-5 but gives 'Skill' at 2+ items; the mirror deliberately chose Swain there and flagged it for this audit to confirm. I confirm it: whys[6], spikes[2], spikes[3] and content.late all say the matchup 'fully flips' at two items, that his MR never keeps pace with the penetration stack, and that a zero-mobility champion cannot leave the drain. Swain is right and the packet's 'Skill' is the stale value.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Skill, rows 3 and 4 to Ornn, row 6 to Swain, in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings rescaled. Rows 0, 2 and 5 already matched.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] described level 2 as Ornn's, which contradicted the corrected chart row.
audit.why: The chart now reads Skill at Level 2 and the text has to say the same thing or the page answers 'who wins Level 2' twice. On the merits Skill is right: Swain gets Nevermove and its root-plus-pull, Ornn gets Bellows Breath and Brittle, and neither reliably beats the other without a read.
audit.corrected: whys[1] rewritten as a genuine even stage rather than an Ornn stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's phases[3] and phases[6] were pure boilerplate — 'the lane-control window' and 'your pattern is at full power' — naming no Ornn mechanic at either stage.
audit.why: Levels 4-5 belong to Ornn because pillar-into-Searing-Charge is a knockup he can land on a champion who must stand at 850 to use his own kit. Two items belong to Swain because Living Forge's bonus resists stop keeping pace with penetration and Ornn has no mobility to leave the drain radius.
audit.corrected: Both phase whys rewritten around the real mechanic.

audit.whatIsWrong: Living Forge was never mentioned on the page even though 'Build magic pen' is one of the three Do's — the Do gave the instruction without the reason.
audit.why: Ornn gains additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from ALL sources, so every MR item he buys is worth more on him than on anyone else. That is the reason penetration is the answer rather than raw AP, and it is also why he out-scales a flat-damage build.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d and tldr now state it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Volcanic Rupture is called 'Wall-knockup setup' in three places (dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t) with no cooldown anywhere, and Bellows Breath's Brittle is never tied to a dodgeable part of the cast.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s at 800 range. Bellows Breath only applies Brittle to enemies hit by the FINAL gout of flame, which makes it a positional dodge rather than an unavoidable debuff. Nevermove roots on the return pass and is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — the mirror states the same return-pass detail from Ornn's side.
audit.corrected: All three Volcanic Rupture lines now carry the cooldown and the accurate pillar-as-terrain description; dontsFull[1].d states the final-gout condition; dontsFull[2].d states the return pass.

notes: All four entries in packet.suspectNames for this matchup are FALSE POSITIVES: 'Volcanic Rupture' (twice), 'Bellows Breath' and 'Demonic Ascension' are the correct names and the strings are right as written. The detector is matching each name against its own lowercase form at edit distance 2-4. The genuine error on this page was not a name at all — it was wants.foe[0] attributing the knockup to the wrong ability. If the name checker is going to keep firing on correct names it should case-fold before measuring distance, otherwise every proper noun on the site is a permanent suspect. Also confirming the mirror's open question: I agree that 2+ items belongs to Swain rather than the packet's 'Skill', for the reasons in point 2 — so both directions now say Swain and mirror-fix should have nothing to reconcile.
